---
title: "Mathematical Biology at NIMBioS"
toc: false
---

For decades, work at the interface of mathematics and biology has been core to the University of Tennessee, Knoxville. NIMBioS grew out of this tradition, resulting in discoveries in areas ranging from disease ecology to paleontology. That work continues; below are some recent publications by NIMBioS [affiliate](affiliates/index.html) faculty. NIMBioS has also fostered tens of millions of dollars of federal investment in research (current active grants (as of October, 2026) total over $20M), resulting in new innovations and publications, and, perhaps even more importantly, training of dozens of scientists as grad students and postdocs.

Historically, one of NIMBioS' biggest impacts has been through working groups and catalysis meetings. Groups of researchers would propose a synthetic topic and, if approved, NIMBioS would support one or more visits from researchers around the world to Knoxville to work through this topic. These topics would commonly span various areas of mathematics, biology, and computing; a key skill was for participants to be able to translate questions and jargon across domains.

<style>

  padding: .05rem .5rem; font-size: .75rem; margin-right: .3rem;
}

  padding: .85rem 1rem; border-radius: .375rem; color: #7d2820;
}
#orcid-papers .orcid-footnote { font-size: .82rem; color: #58595b; margin-top: 1rem; }

<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  // ---- configuration ------------------------------------------------------
  // orcid.csv is the single source of truth for which ORCID iDs to query.
  // The same-directory path is tried first; the others are fallbacks for
  // different deployments / local preview.
  var CSV_PATHS   = ["orcid.csv",      // same directory as this page
                     "../orcid.csv",   // one directory up
                     "/orcid.csv"];    // site root
  var CSV_COLUMN  = "Orcid ID";  // matched case/punctuation-insensitively
  var MAX_PAPERS  = 10;          // how many to display
  var DETAIL_POOL = 18;          // top candidates that get a full-detail fetch
  var CONCURRENCY = 6;           // simultaneous ORCID requests
  var API         = "https://pub.orcid.org/v3.0";

  var container = document.getElementById("orcid-papers");
  if (!container) return;

  function status(msg) {
    container.innerHTML = '<p class="orcid-status">' + msg + "</p>";
  }

  function getJSON(url) {
    return fetch(url, { headers: { Accept: "application/json" } }).then(function (r) {
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error(url + " returned " + r.status);
      return r.json();
    });
  }

  // ---- CSV parsing --------------------------------------------------------
  // Full RFC-4180 handling: quoted fields, embedded commas, escaped quotes,
  // newlines inside quotes, and CRLF line endings.
  function parseCSV(text) {
    text = text.replace(/^\uFEFF/, "");           // strip BOM
    var rows = [], row = [], field = "", inQuotes = false, i = 0;

    while (i < text.length) {
      var c = text[i];
      if (inQuotes) {
        if (c === '"') {
          if (text[i + 1] === '"') { field += '"'; i += 2; continue; }
          inQuotes = false; i++; continue;
        }
        field += c; i++; continue;
      }
      if (c === '"') { inQuotes = true; i++; continue; }
      if (c === ",") { row.push(field); field = ""; i++; continue; }
      if (c === "\r") { i++; continue; }
      if (c === "\n") { row.push(field); rows.push(row); row = []; field = ""; i++; continue; }
      field += c; i++;
    }
    row.push(field);
    rows.push(row);
    return rows.filter(function (r) {
      return r.some(function (v) { return v.trim() !== ""; });
    });
  }

  function normalizeHeader(h) {
    return String(h).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "");
  }

  // Pull the bare 16-digit iD out of whatever the cell contains:
  // "https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0337-5997", "orcid.org/0000-...", or the raw iD.
  var ORCID_RE = /(\d{4}-\d{4}-\d{4}-\d{3}[\dX])/i;

  function extractOrcid(cell) {
    if (!cell) return null;
    var m = String(cell).match(ORCID_RE);
    return m ? m[1].toUpperCase() : null;
  }

  function orcidsFromCSV(text) {
    var rows = parseCSV(text);
    if (!rows.length) return [];

    var header  = rows[0].map(normalizeHeader);
    var wanted  = normalizeHeader(CSV_COLUMN);
    var col     = header.indexOf(wanted);

    // Fall back to any header merely containing "orcid" (e.g. "ORCID iD (URL)").
    if (col === -1) {
      col = header.findIndex(function (h) { return h.indexOf("orcid") !== -1; });
    }

    var cells;
    if (col === -1) {
      // No usable header (or a headerless file): scan every cell, including the
      // first row, so a plain one-iD-per-line file works too.
      cells = rows.reduce(function (acc, r) { return acc.concat(r); }, []);
    } else {
      cells = rows.slice(1).map(function (r) { return r[col]; });
    }

    var seen = Object.create(null), out = [];
    cells.forEach(function (cell) {
      var id = extractOrcid(cell);
      if (id && !seen[id]) { seen[id] = true; out.push(id); }
    });
    return out;
  }

  // ---- date handling ------------------------------------------------------
  // ORCID dates are frequently year-only or year+month. Missing parts sort last
  // within their year so a dated paper outranks an undated one from the same year.
  function parseDate(d) {
    if (!d) return { y: 0, m: 0, day: 0, text: "" };
    var y = d.year  && d.year.value  ? parseInt(d.year.value, 10)  : 0;
    var m = d.month && d.month.value ? parseInt(d.month.value, 10) : 0;
    var g = d.day   && d.day.value   ? parseInt(d.day.value, 10)   : 0;
    var months = ["", "January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June",
                  "July", "August", "September", "October", "November", "December"];
    var text = "";
    if (y) text = m ? (months[m] + " " + y) : String(y);
    return { y: y, m: m, day: g, text: text };
  }

  function sortKey(p) { return p.date.y * 10000 + p.date.m * 100 + p.date.day; }

  // ---- identifier extraction ---------------------------------------------
  function externalIds(summary) {
    var ids = {};
    var list = (summary["external-ids"] && summary["external-ids"]["external-id"]) || [];
    list.forEach(function (x) {
      var type = (x["external-id-type"] || "").toLowerCase();
      var val  = x["external-id-value"];
      if (val && !ids[type]) ids[type] = val;
    });
    return ids;
  }

  function bestUrl(ids, summary) {
    if (ids.doi) {
      return "https://doi.org/" + ids.doi.replace(/^https?:\/\/(dx\.)?doi\.org\//i, "");
    }
    if (ids.pmid)  return "https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/" + ids.pmid + "/";
    if (ids.arxiv) return "https://arxiv.org/abs/" + ids.arxiv.replace(/^arxiv:/i, "");
    if (summary.url && summary.url.value) return summary.url.value;
    return null;
  }

  // Co-authored papers appear once per ORCID record; collapse them.
  function dedupeKey(p) {
    if (p.ids.doi)  return "doi:" + p.ids.doi.toLowerCase().replace(/^https?:\/\/(dx\.)?doi\.org\//i, "");
    if (p.ids.pmid) return "pmid:" + p.ids.pmid;
    return "title:" + p.title.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, " ").trim();
  }

  // ---- throttled fetching -------------------------------------------------
  // The CSV can hold many iDs; firing every request at once would get the
  // browser (or ORCID) to start dropping them.
  function pool(items, limit, worker) {
    var results = [], index = 0, active = [];
    function next() {
      if (index >= items.length) return null;
      var i = index++;
      return Promise.resolve(worker(items[i], i)).then(function (r) { results[i] = r; });
    }
    for (var k = 0; k < Math.min(limit, items.length); k++) {
      active.push((function run() {
        var p = next();
        return p ? p.then(run) : Promise.resolve();
      })());
    }
    return Promise.all(active).then(function () { return results; });
  }

  function fetchWorks(orcid) {
    return getJSON(API + "/" + orcid + "/works")
      .then(function (data) {
        return (data.group || []).map(function (g) {
          var s = g["work-summary"] && g["work-summary"][0];
          if (!s) return null;
          var ids = externalIds(s);
          return {
            orcid:   orcid,
            putCode: s["put-code"],
            title:   (s.title && s.title.title && s.title.title.value) || "Untitled",
            journal: (s["journal-title"] && s["journal-title"].value) || "",
            type:    (s.type || "").replace(/-/g, " ").toLowerCase(),
            date:    parseDate(s["publication-date"]),
            ids:     ids,
            url:     bestUrl(ids, s),
            authors: null
          };
        }).filter(Boolean);
      })
      .catch(function (err) {
        console.warn("ORCID fetch failed for " + orcid, err);
        return [];   // one unreachable record must not blank the whole list
      });
  }

  // ---- contributor filtering ----------------------------------------------
  // ORCID lists authors AND editors (and other roles) together in the
  // contributor array. Keep authors; drop anyone whose stated role is editor.
  // A missing role is treated as author, which is how most records are entered.
  function isEditorRole(role) {
    return String(role || "").toLowerCase().indexOf("editor") !== -1;
  }

  function contributorAuthors(work) {
    var list = (work.contributors && work.contributors.contributor) || [];
    var seen = Object.create(null), names = [];
    list.forEach(function (c) {
      var name = c["credit-name"] && c["credit-name"].value;
      if (!name) return;
      var attrs = c["contributor-attributes"] || {};
      if (isEditorRole(attrs["contributor-role"])) return;   // skip editors
      var key = name.toLowerCase();
      if (!seen[key]) { seen[key] = true; names.push(name); }  // same person, multiple roles
    });
    return names;
  }

  // ---- author lists in bulk ----------------------------------------------
  // Work summaries omit contributors, so pull details for the shortlist only.
  // The bulk endpoint accepts up to 100 comma-separated put-codes per iD.
  function fetchDetails(papers) {
    var byOrcid = {};
    papers.forEach(function (p) { (byOrcid[p.orcid] = byOrcid[p.orcid] || []).push(p); });

    return pool(Object.keys(byOrcid), CONCURRENCY, function (orcid) {
      var group = byOrcid[orcid];
      var codes = group.map(function (p) { return p.putCode; }).slice(0, 100).join(",");
      return getJSON(API + "/" + orcid + "/works/" + codes)
        .then(function (data) {
          (data.bulk || []).forEach(function (item) {
            var w = item.work;
            if (!w) return;
            var match = group.filter(function (p) { return p.putCode === w["put-code"]; })[0];
            if (!match) return;
            var names = contributorAuthors(w);
            if (names.length) match.authors = names;
            if (!match.journal && w["journal-title"] && w["journal-title"].value) {
              match.journal = w["journal-title"].value;
            }
          });
        })
        .catch(function (err) { console.warn("Detail fetch failed for " + orcid, err); });
    }).then(function () { return papers; });
  }

  // ---- rendering ----------------------------------------------------------
  function esc(s) {
    return String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) {
      return { "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" }[c];
    });
  }

  function authorLine(names) {
    if (!names || !names.length) return "";
    var shown = names.slice(0, 8).map(esc).join(", ");
    if (names.length > 8) shown += ", et al.";
    return '<div class="paper-authors">' + shown + "</div>";
  }

  function render(papers, orcidCount) {
    if (!papers.length) {
      container.innerHTML = '<div class="orcid-error">No publications could be ' +
        "retrieved from ORCID right now. Please try again later.</div>";
      return;
    }

    var html = "<ol>";
    papers.forEach(function (p) {
      var title = p.url
        ? '<a href="' + esc(p.url) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">' + esc(p.title) + "</a>"
        : esc(p.title);

      var meta = [];
      if (p.journal)   meta.push('<span class="journal">' + esc(p.journal) + "</span>");
      if (p.date.text) meta.push(esc(p.date.text));
      if (p.type && p.type !== "journal article") meta.push(esc(p.type));

      html += '<li class="paper">' +
                '<div class="paper-title">' + title + "</div>" +
                authorLine(p.authors) +
                '<div class="paper-meta">' +
                  '<span class="badge-orcid">ORCID</span>' +
                  meta.join('<span class="sep">·</span>') +
                "</div>" +
              "</li>";
    });
    html += "</ol>";

    html += '<p class="orcid-footnote">Aggregated live from ' + orcidCount +
            " ORCID record" + (orcidCount === 1 ? "" : "s") +
            "; co-authored papers are listed once and editors are not shown in " +
            "the author line. Records with no publication date on file may be " +
            "ordered by year only.</p>";

    container.innerHTML = html;
  }

  // ---- load the CSV, then run --------------------------------------------
  function loadCSV(paths) {
    if (!paths.length) return Promise.reject(new Error("orcid.csv not found"));
    return fetch(paths[0])
      .then(function (r) {
        if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.status);
        return r.text();
      })
      .catch(function () { return loadCSV(paths.slice(1)); });
  }

  loadCSV(CSV_PATHS)
    .then(function (csv) {
      var orcids = orcidsFromCSV(csv);
      if (!orcids.length) {
        throw new Error("no ORCID iDs found in orcid.csv");
      }
      status("Loading publications for " + orcids.length + " ORCID record" +
             (orcids.length === 1 ? "" : "s") + "…");

      return pool(orcids, CONCURRENCY, fetchWorks).then(function (lists) {
        var all = lists.reduce(function (a, b) { return a.concat(b); }, []);

        all.sort(function (a, b) { return sortKey(b) - sortKey(a); });

        var seen = Object.create(null), unique = [];
        all.forEach(function (p) {
          var k = dedupeKey(p);
          if (!seen[k]) { seen[k] = true; unique.push(p); }
        });

        var shortlist = unique.slice(0, Math.max(DETAIL_POOL, MAX_PAPERS));
        return fetchDetails(shortlist).then(function () {
          render(shortlist.slice(0, MAX_PAPERS), orcids.length);
        });
      });
    })
    .catch(function (err) {
      console.error(err);
      container.innerHTML = '<div class="orcid-error"><strong>Could not build the ' +
        "publication list.</strong><br>" + esc(err.message) +
        "<br>Expected a CSV named <code>orcid.csv</code> containing ORCID iDs.</div>";
    });
})();
</script>

[Note that the script loading data from orcid was created by Anthropic's Claude Fable 5, hosted on the University of Tennessee, Knoxville's [AI Hub](https://oit.utk.edu/ai/aihub/), prompted by Brian O'Meara]
